title: DeepSeek-V3.2 with DeepSeek Sparse Attention
before: Latent attention had reduced the KV cache, but attention cost still grew with length.
problem: Long-context inference remained expensive per token as sequences grew.
breakthrough: A trainable sparse attention mechanism that selects which past tokens to attend to, cutting long-context cost sharply.
why: It revived sparse attention as a frontier technique rather than a compromise, and cut long-context prices.
inherits: Learned sparsity as the current answer to long-context cost.
